section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study (Study 1) that examined the psychometric properties of the Persian Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2) in Iran. The study included 568 men and 525 women (total N=1093) from seven universities in Tehran, with separate exploratory factor analyses conducted for each gender. The Persian BAS-2 demonstrated a one-factor solution similar to the original English version and showed satisfactory convergent validity and internal consistency, with men scoring significantly higher than women on the measure.
